note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 21 November 2026, RealHunt lists 10 homes for sale in Switzerland, each one checked by a person.
In Switzerland, the median asking price of those 10 homes is €70,100 (€2,337 per m², from the 10 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €32,300 and the most expensive €88,400.
Taxes and fees add about 1–5% to the price of a home in Switzerland (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer, droits de mutation) 0% to about 3.3% depending on the canton; notary about 0.1-0.5%; land register fee, a small fixed amount or percentage; optional lawyer 1-2%; the agent fee (2-3%) is paid by the seller.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Under the Lex Koller law, EU/EFTA citizens living in Switzerland and holders of a C permit buy like Swiss citizens, and non-EU holders of a B permit can buy a home they live in. People living abroad need a cantonal permit and can usually only buy one holiday home in a tourist area, within national quotas; a proposed tightening was under consultation in 2026.
buying.annual_property_tax: More than half of the cantons charge an annual property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer), usually 0.01-0.3% of the assessed value, and owners also pay cantonal wealth tax on the property value minus the mortgage.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents pay tax on net Swiss rental income at ordinary cantonal and communal rates plus federal direct tax, and some cantons set the rate using worldwide income.

homes.title: 70 m² modular house with heat pump, to move to your own plot
homes.title_es: Casa modular de 70 m² con bomba de calor, para llevar a tu propio terreno
homes.summary: Four solid living modules under a classic pitched roof, about 70 m² gross: kitchen with fridge and oven, a bright open living and dining room, and a bathroom with shower, toilet and washing machine. Air-to-water heat pump with radiators, about 12 years old and well kept. Read this before you fall for it: only the house is sold, not the land. The buyer organises and pays for taking it down and moving it from Lengnau; it stands on a point foundation, which makes that easier. Asking price CHF 30,000, about €32,300. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Holiday cottage with winter garden by a bathing lake in Salgesch
homes.title_es: Casita de vacaciones con jardín de invierno junto a un lago de baño en Salgesch
homes.summary: About 40 m² on a plot of around 180 m² at Camping Swissplage, with a winter garden, an outdoor seating area for barbecues and a garden shed. The campsite has a bathing lake, a restaurant, a playground and a small animal enclosure, in the wine village of Salgesch between Sierre and Leuk. Parking is public (120 m away) or a private space can be rented. Campsite pitch, so a yearly fee applies. Asking price CHF 49,000, about €52,800. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Fenced 2.5-room camping house with a sunny terrace in Raron
homes.title_es: Casa de camping vallada de 2,5 habitaciones con terraza soleada en Raron
homes.summary: A wooden camping house of about 45 m², fenced for privacy: furnished kitchen, a living corner and a dining area, a shower room, and two more bedrooms with four beds in the adjoining caravan section. A big terrace for breakfast in the sun, on a 160 m² pitch at the St. Monica campsite in Raron, surrounded by vineyards and mountains. Campsite pitch, so a yearly fee applies. Asking price CHF 39,500, about €42,600. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Year-round wooden chalet with garden and pool access near Lake Zurich
homes.title_es: Chalet de madera para todo el año con jardín y piscina cerca del lago de Zúrich
homes.summary: Two bedrooms, an open living and kitchen area and a bathroom in about 50 m², on a 189 m² pitch in the Ricken leisure park above Lake Zurich. It comes with air conditioning for heating and cooling, a new washing machine and toilet, and a private parking space. The park has a swimming pool and two tennis courts, with hiking and cross-country skiing from the door. Ready to use now. The pitch is rented: about CHF 5,832 a year (2026) including water and basic fees, plus electricity, and a new pitch contract is signed with the operator. It is a holiday and weekend home; it cannot be registered as a main residence. Asking price CHF 74,900, about €80,700. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Renovated chalet with garden in a green campsite in the Neuchâtel hills
homes.title_es: Chalet reformado con jardín en un camping verde de las colinas de Neuchâtel
homes.summary: A renovated 1.5-room chalet of about 30 m² on a plot of around 150 m², with large sliding windows, a new kitchen and a shower room. The campsite has a pool, a playground, a padel court and a supermarket 50 m away, and the bus is 150 m away. The land rent is CHF 2,400 a year. Leisure or second-home use only, not a main residence. Asking price CHF 65,000, about €70,100. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Winter-proof wooden chalet by a stream in the Valais Alps
homes.title_es: Chalet de madera preparado para el invierno junto a un arroyo en los Alpes del Valais
homes.summary: A 2.5-room chalet of about 48 m² in a quiet corner of the 4-star Camping Santa Monica in Raron, right on the stream, usable all year. Kitchen with dishwasher and gas hob, fly screens on every window, a covered terrace with an outdoor fireplace, an 8 m² cellar, a laundry room and a small parking space. Last renovated in February 2026. The campsite has a heated pool, a restaurant and a shop, and Zermatt, Saas-Fee and the Aletsch Glacier are day trips away. It stands on a campsite pitch, so expect a yearly pitch fee and the campsite rules. Asking price CHF 69,500, about €74,900. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Wooden tiny house with two lofts and a wood stove, ready to move
homes.title_es: Tiny house de madera con dos altillos y estufa de leña, lista para trasladar
homes.summary: A newly built tiny house: about 25 m² with an open living area, a custom kitchen with induction hob and oven, a shower room with flush toilet, two sleeping lofts and ceilings up to 3.26 m. Infrared underfloor heating plus a wood-burning stove, spruce facade and an insulated roof. It sits on a light trailer (7.3 × 2.55 m), so you place it on a campsite or a plot where the rules allow it. Shown near Brig. Asking price CHF 55,000, about €59,300. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Mobile home with 120 m² garden, gazebo and pellet heating in Valais
homes.title_es: Casa móvil con 120 m² de jardín, cenador y calefacción de pellets en el Valais
homes.summary: The 'Bijou' mobile home: 34 m² of living space plus a veranda, on a 213 m² plot with about 120 m² of garden, a gazebo with lounge and an outdoor fireplace. Granite kitchen worktop, shower room, pellet heating with underfloor heating and a pellet stove. Built in 2000, renovated in 2015 and sold with all furniture. It sits at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac at Camping Santa Monica in Raron, with the campsite pool, golf in Leuk and the ski areas nearby. Campsite rules and a yearly fee apply. Asking price CHF 79,700, about €85,900. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Bright as-new tiny house with sleeping loft and heat pump
homes.title_es: Tiny house luminosa como nueva, con altillo para dormir y bomba de calor
homes.summary: Built in 2023 and as new: about 20 m² with an open living and dining area, a kitchenette with induction hob, a modern shower room and a sleeping loft under a 3.26 m ceiling. Heated by an air-to-water heat pump, double-glazed and well insulated. Available now and mobile, so it can go on a campsite or a suitable plot under the local rules. Shown near Brig. Asking price CHF 55,000, about €59,300. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.

homes.title: Like-new furnished camping house in the sunny Upper Valais
homes.title_es: Casa de camping amueblada como nueva en el soleado Alto Valais
homes.summary: Only two years old and sold furnished: about 34 m² with a cosy living area, kitchen, bathroom and bedroom, shutters and fly screens, plus extras the seller values at around CHF 15,000. Private parking at the door and a barbecue spot outside, in a quiet, sunny part of the St. Monica campsite in Raron. It is a holiday home on a campsite pitch, so a yearly pitch fee applies. Asking price CHF 82,000, about €88,400. Buying in Switzerland as a non-resident foreigner is limited by the Lex Koller rules; ask the agent whether you qualify before you go further.
